risks.risk: May not reliably inflate or may leak/lose pressure after pumping (cannot be confirmed without a test).

risks.if_unproven: Priced as not reliably holding pressure / treat as needs servicing (worst case: not working).

risks.risk: Connector/nozzle may not fit the buyer’s intended valve type (ball vs bicycle vs inflatable mattress).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the exact connector/nozzle end and any included adapters laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly missing the correct adapter (worst case: limited compatibility).

risks.risk: Pump head/valve may be worn or damaged in a way not visible in photo 0.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the pump head/valve area plus a pumping video showing smooth operation (no knocking).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown internal condition (worst case: may need repair).

risks.risk: “Never opened/low mileage” cannot be verified remotely without labels/serials or tamper evidence.
risks.proof: Photo of any serial/label and clear shots of seals/fasteners; ideally a video showing the valve assembly without disassembly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown history (worst case: higher wear).

Send close-up photos of the connector/nozzle end and any adapters included.

response.reason: The seller’s text repeats the same claims, but without a new working test clip or clearer photos, photo 0 still cannot confirm that it inflates reliably or holds pressure, nor confirm compatibility. So the safest approach is to request proof before pricing.
